H4210: properly, instrumental music; by implication, a poem set to notes
H1732: David, the youngest son of Jesse
H3068: Jehovah, Jewish national name of God
H7121: to call out to (i.e. properly, address by name, but used in a wide variety of applications)
H2363: to hurry; figuratively, to be eager with excitement or enjoyment
H238: to broaden out the ear (with the hand), i.e. (by implication) to listen
H3559: properly, to be erect (i.e. stand perpendicular); hence (causatively) to set up, in a great variety of applications, whether literal (establish, fix, prepare, apply), or figurative (appoint, render sure, proper or prosperous)
H8605: intercession, supplication; by implication, a hymn
H6440: the face (as the part that turns); used in a great variety of applications (literally and figuratively); also (with prepositional prefix) as a preposition (before, etc.)
H4864: properly, (abstractly) a raising (as of the hands in prayer), or rising (of flame); figuratively, an utterance; concretely, a beacon (as raised); a present (as taken), mess, or tribute; figuratively, a reproach (as a burden)
H3709: the hollow hand or palm (so of the paw of an animal, of the sole, and even of the bowl of a dish or sling, the handle of a bolt, the leaves of a palm-tree); figuratively, power
H4503: a donation; euphemistically, tribute; specifically a sacrificial offering (usually bloodless and voluntary)
H7896: to place (in a very wide application)
H6310: the mouth (as the means of blowing), whether literal or figurative (particularly speech); specifically edge, portion or side; adverbially (with preposition) according to
H5341: to guard, in a good sense (to protect, maintain, obey, etc.) or a bad one (to conceal, etc.)
H5921: above, over, upon, or against (yet always in this last relation with a downward aspect) in a great variety of applications
H1817: something swinging, i.e. the valve of adoor
H8193: the lip (as a natural boundary); by implication, language; by analogy, a margin (of a vessel, water, cloth, etc.)
H408: not (the qualified negation, used as a deprecative); once (Job 24:25) as a noun, nothing
H5186: to stretch or spread out; by implication, to bend away (including moral deflection); used in a great variety of application
H3820: the heart; also used (figuratively) very widely for the feelings, the will and even the intellect; likewise for the centre of anything
H1697: a word; by implication, a matter (as spoken of) or thing; adverbially, a cause
H7451: bad or (as noun) evil (natural or moral)
H5953: to effect thoroughly; specifically, to glean (also figuratively); by implication (in a bad sense) to overdo, i.e. maltreat, be saucy to, pain, impose (also literal)
H5949: an exploit (of God), or a performance (of man, often in a bad sense); by implication, an opportunity
H854: properly, nearness (used only as a preposition or an adverb), near; hence, generally, with, by, at, among, etc.
H376: a man as an individual or a male person; often used as an adjunct to a more definite term (and in such cases frequently not expressed in translation)
H6466: to do or make (systematically and habitually), especially to practise
H205: strictly nothingness; also trouble. vanity, wickedness; specifically an idol
H1077: properly, a failure; by implication nothing; usually (adverb) not at all; also lest
H3898: to feed on; figuratively, to consume; by implication, to battle (as destruction)
H1986: to strike down; by implication, to hammer, stamp, conquer, disband
H2617: kindness; by implication (towards God) piety; rarely (by opposition) reproof, or (subject.) beauty
H3198: to be right (i.e. correct); reciprocal, to argue; causatively, to decide, justify or convict
H8081: grease, especially liquid (as from the olive, often perfumed); figuratively, richness
H7218: the head (as most easily shaken), whether literal or figurative (in many applications, of place, time, rank, itc.)
H5106: to refuse, forbid, dissuade, or neutralize
H3588: (by implication) very widely used as a relative conjunction or adverb (as below); often largely modified by other particles annexed
H5750: properly, iteration or continuance; used only adverbially (with or without preposition), again, repeatedly, still, more
H8058: to fling down; incipiently to jostle; figuratively, to let alone, desist, remit
H3027: a hand (the open one (indicating power, means, direction, etc.),
H5553: a craggy rock, literally or figuratively (a fortress)
H8199: to judge, i.e. pronounce sentence (for or against); by implication, to vindicate or punish; by extenssion, to govern; passively, to litigate (literally or figuratively)
H8085: to hear intelligently (often with implication of attention, obedience, etc.; causatively, to tell, etc.)
H3644: a form of the prefix 'k-', but used separately as, thus, so
H6398: to slice, i.e. break open or pierce
H1234: to cleave; generally, to rend, break, rip or open
H776: the earth (at large, or partitively a land)
H6340: to scatter, whether in enmity or bounty
H6106: a bone (as strong); by extension, the body; figuratively, the substance, i.e. (as pron.) selfsame
H7585: Hades or the world of the dead (as if a subterranean retreat), including its accessories and inmates
H413: near, with or among; often in general, to
H136: the Lord (used as a proper name of God only)
H5869: an eye (literally or figuratively); by analogy, a fountain (as the eye of the landscape)
H2620: to flee for protection; figuratively, to confide in
H6168: to be (causatively, make) bare; hence, to empty, pour out, demolish
H5315: properly, a breathing creature, i.e. animal of (abstractly) vitality; used very widely in a literal, accommodated or figurative sense (bodily or mental)
H8104: properly, to hedge about (as with thorns), i.e. guard; generally, to protect, attend to, etc.
H6341: a (metallic) sheet (as pounded thin); also a spring net (as spread out like a lamina)
H4170: a noose (for catching animals) (literally or figuratively); by implication, a hook (for the nose)
H5307: to fall, in a great variety of applications (intransitive or causative, literal or figurative)
H7563: morally wrong; concretely, an (actively) bad person
H5704: as far (or long, or much) as, whether of space (even unto) or time (during, while, until) or degree (equally with)
H5674: to cross over; used very widely of any transition (literal or figurative; transitive, intransitive, intensive, causative); specifically, to cover (in copulation)
